# ai/compose

A built-in compose adapter for records of any type: it needs the step's `uses:` fields and provides 2 fields. It publishes no per-record estimate, so plan prints `?`, and it runs without a key, though `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID` are optional.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `ai/compose` |
| version | 1 |
| role | compose |
| entity type | any type |
| credentials | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (optional), `ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID` (optional) |
| cost estimate per record | not published |

## Needs

The fields the step's `uses:` line names, and nothing else.

## Provides

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "first_line": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ps_line": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `batch_size` | integer |  |  |
| `deferred` | boolean |  | ADR-038: submit the batch to the engine's batch surface (the Message Batches API, half price) and end the run in flight; the next `gtme run` of the pipeline collects. Valid only on the pipeline's last step. |
| `fence` | boolean |  | ADR-035: wrap externally fetched fields in a delimiter labelled as subject-supplied data (default true); false opts out |
| `fetched` | array of string |  | The batch's externally fetched fields (ADR-035). Injected by the runner from provenance — never authored inside with:. |
| `fields` | array of string |  | Restrict what the model sees to these fields (default: everything known) |
| `max_tokens` | integer |  |  |
| `model` | string |  |  |
| `of` | string |  | The referent (ADR-048): the field whose value this step is about, presented to the model as the subject. Injected by the runner from the step-level of: key — never authored inside with:. |
| `provides` | object |  | The step's derived provides schema (ADR-033). Injected by the runner from the step-level provides: key — never authored inside with:. |
| `template` | string | yes | The operator's text (ADR-057): a template rendered once per step over config.* — the shared block the records follow (SPEC §10.3). The runner loads {file:} and renders before OPEN; the adapter receives text. |

## Example

From [See it run](/start/show-me):

```yaml
  - id: lines
    use: ai/compose
    when: fit.passed
    uses: [full_name, title, company_name]
    with:
      template: >
        Write first_line and ps_line for a short, honest intro email.
```
